name: Prismatic Ruin
description: Every enemy in both rows takes 2.4× spell Attack as the element it is weakest to among Fire, Frost and Lightning (Fire if none; immunities respected), then Burn 2, Chill 1 and Shock 2. You refund 30% of max Mana. 100 Momentum; weight 1,400 but cannot be interrupted; never misses.

effects.note: deals multiplier × spell Attack as whichever of Fire, Frost and Lightning the target is weakest to; Fire when none; an immune element is never chosen
refund 30% of max Mana on resolution

mastery.text: No Mastery line beyond rank scaling: the sheet names none for the Ultimate.
